actions.name: Cargo Ejection
actions.text: The cargo bay of an ATech Gold Spacer Truck instantly detaches and moves 1 zone away in the event the starship is destroyed, often ejecting at the same time and in the same direction as the starship’s escape pods.

actions.name: Starskim
actions.text: Requirements The Sentinel has 5 SP; Effect The Sentinel uses its shields as sails. Increase its Speed to 5 zones, and it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC, but reduces its SP to 0. This effect ends when the Sentinel uses Fortify Shield Points.

actions.name: machine gun
actions.text: (2-zone cone, analog), Damage 2d4 piercing (DC 17 basic Reflex save)

actions.name: Dropship Cables
actions.text: The Canopyskipper can deploy or retrieve up to eight cables at once up to 300 feet downward, each of which can be held onto or Climbed with a successful DC 10 Athletics check. At the ends of each of these cables is a magnet capable of lifting up to 6 Bulk and are intended to affix to armor. They require a creature adjacent to the magnet to use an Interact action to attach the cable. Multiple cables can be used to lift larger loads, with each additional cable increasing the amount of Bulk that can be lifted by 6.

actions.name: Deploy Remote Turret
actions.text: The Kevolari Wanderlust deploys a remote turret in its current zone. The turret is a tiny starship object with AC 18, 8 HP, Hardness 4, and object immunities. The Kevolari Wanderlust can have only two deployed remote turrets at a given time. If it would deploy a third, one of its previously deployed remote turret is destroyed.

actions.name: Orbital Bombardment
actions.text: Frequency once per turn; Effect Each remote turret of the Kevolari Wanderlust’s choice within sensor range targets a starship in its zone and fires a barrage of lasers. Multiple turrets can’t target the same starship. The targets take 2d6 fire damage with a DC 18 basic Reflex save.

actions.name: Shield Scramble
actions.text: Requirements At least two remote turrets are currently deployed; Effect The satellites target a starship within the Wanderlust’s sensor range with a deluge of electromagnetic waves to disrupt the target’s shields. The target must succeed at a DC 18 Fortitude save or else its generator can’t use Fortify Shield Points until a creature helming the station uses an Interact action to restore shield generation capabilities with a successful DC 18 Crafting

actions.name: Drift Sense
actions.text: The dragon can always sense the distance and direction to the nearest Drift beacon and to the Starstone on Absalom Station.

actions.name: Attunement Aura
actions.text: 1 zone. Allied starships in the aura gain a +1-zone status bonus to Speed (if dragon is photon-attuned), or enemies take a –1-zone status penalty to Speed (if dragon is graviton-attuned). These effects apply at the start of the starship’s turn and end at the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Living Starship
actions.text: See page 208.

actions.name: Engaged Strike
actions.text: claw (page 208)

actions.name: Cosmic Attunement
actions.text: The dragon is always attuned to an underlying stellar force: either photons or gravitons. They can swap attunement as a free action once at the start of their turn in combat and is otherwise attuned to whichever force they choose at any time outside of combat. While photon-attuned, the dragon’s melee Strikes deal an additional 2d6 fire damage; while graviton-attuned, their melee Strikes deal additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage plus the target becomes off-guard until the end of the dragon’s current turn. The damage of their cosmic blast Strike is determined by their current attunement (fire for photons and bludgeoning for gravitons), as are the effects of some of their other abilities.

actions.name: Draconic Frenzy
actions.text: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

actions.name: Draconic Momentum
actions.text: The dragon recharges their Stellar Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

actions.name: Stellar Breath
actions.text: The dragon unleashes divine power like that from the core of a star or black hole, dealing 4d10 cold damage in a 1-zone cone (DC 22 basic Will save). Starships immune to cold damage take bludgeoning or fire damage instead (see cosmic attunement). The dragon can’t use Stellar Breath for 1d4 rounds.

actions.name: Engaged Strike
actions.text: shield bash (page 208)

actions.name: Overclock Shield
actions.text: Requirements The Moonhopper has 30 Shield Points; Effect Lower the number of Shield Points the Moonhopper has by 15. The next time this turn the Moonhopper makes a shield bash Strike, it deals an additional 3d6 electricity damage.

actions.name: Shield Drain
actions.text: The Moonhopper’s iconic shield-draining technology makes it a powerful tool for Starfinders. The first time each turn that the Moonhopper successfully hits a target with its shield bash, it gains SP equal to the number of SP its target lost, up to the Moonhopper’s fortify value.

actions.name: Smuggler Compartment
actions.text: The Moonlighter has a secure compartment below the main deck for cargo, which scanners have trouble detecting due to the hull’s shape. The compartment can hold up to 48 Bulk. Creatures gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks and DCs to hide or conceal themselves or equipment in this compartment.

actions.name: wraith torpedo ×2
actions.text: (1-zone burst, consumable, range 3 zones, razing, tech), Damage 8d6 cold (DC 23 basic Reflex save)

actions.name: Cloak Starship
actions.text: Frequency once per day; Effect The Aspis Moonlighter becomes invisible for 1 hour. This makes it undetected to all starships, though starships can attempt to Seek Starships against it, making it hidden to them instead. If the Moonlighter uses a hostile action, the invisibility ends after that hostile action is completed. Stealth Torpedo System These large missiles are invisible until they explode and firing them doesn’t end the Moonlighter’s Cloak Starship ability. As long as the Moonlighter is invisible, only enemies who can see the Moonlighter can use reactions against the Area Fire of a wraith torpedo.

actions.name: Nova Ball
actions.text: Resistances three times per day; Effect The Cantripper creates an explosion mimicking the death of a star in a zone within sensor range. Starships in that zone take 6d6 fire damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save).

actions.name: Drift Sense
actions.text: As Skyfire Star Dragon. — [Skyfire Star Dragon: The dragon can always sense the distance and direction to the nearest Drift beacon and to the Starstone on Absalom Station.]

These effects apply at the start of the starship’s turn and end at the start of its next turn.]

actions.name: Engaged Strike
actions.text: draconic javelin (page 208)

actions.name: Drill Dive
actions.text: The Trident Boosts Thrusters, barreling toward its foe. If the Trident moves at least 1 zone, a starship within 0 zones takes 3d12 piercing damage and must attempt a DC 24 Fortitude save. Critical Success The target is unaffected. Success The target takes half damage and is off-guard to the next Strike the Trident makes against it for 1 round. Failure The target takes full damage. It’s off-kilter and off-guard while it’s off-kilter. Critical Failure The target takes double damage. It’s off-kilter and off-guard while it’s off-kilter. The Trident can push the target back 1 zone in the direction of the Trident’s heading.

actions.name: Stellar Breath
actions.text: As Skyfire Star Dragon, but a 2-zone cone, 6d10 cold damage, and DC 26. — [Skyfire Star Dragon: The dragon unleashes divine power like that from the core of a star or black hole, dealing 4d10 cold damage in a 1-zone cone (DC 22 basic Will save). Starships immune to cold damage take bludgeoning or fire damage instead (see cosmic attunement). The dragon can’t use Stellar Breath for 1d4 rounds.]

actions.name: Living Starship
actions.text: See page 208.

actions.name: Cavatina
actions.text: See oma (Starfinder Alien Core 127), DC 30, range 1 zone.

actions.name: Overloading Strike
actions.text: When an oma critically hits with its electrostatic discharge Strike, the target must succeed at a DC 30 basic Reflex save or one battle station on the starship of the oma’s choice becomes malfunctioning.

actions.name: Swallow Starship
actions.text: The oma attempts to swallow whole another starship within 0 zones. The target must attempt a DC 30 Reflex save or become swallowed. While swallowed, the starship is immobilized, the oma is off-guard to it, it can target only the oma with any of its abilities, and it can’t be targeted by effects from starships that aren’t swallowed by the oma. Damage dealt against the oma by a starship it has swallowed doesn’t damage its SP but directly damages its HP instead. A creature helming the pilot’s console can attempt a DC 30 Piloting check as a single action that’s a pilot console station action to stop being swallowed. Alternatively, if the

actions.name: Hoist Petard
actions.text: Trigger The Vigilance is targeted by missiles or torpedoes; Requirements There’s another target within range of the Vigilance’s Speed and the triggering attack’s range; Effect The Vigilance Boosts Thrusters and selects one other starship in a zone it passes through to become the new target of the attack, as long as that starship is also within range of the triggering effect. This can include the starship that made the triggering effect.

actions.name: plasma torpedo
actions.text: (1-zone burst, range 5 zones, tech), Damage 5d8 fire (DC 29 basic Reflex save)

actions.name: Emergency Reorientation
actions.text: Trigger The Opulus Drift Cruiser would become off-kilter; Effect The Opulus Drift Cruiser automatically rights itself, losing the off-kilter condition.

actions.name: flak thrower
actions.text: (1-zone burst, concussive, range 5 zones, tech), Damage 5d8 bludgeoning (DC 29 basic Reflex save) plus micrometeor cloud Micrometeor Cloud The nearest zone to the Opulus Drift Cruiser affected by the flak thrower’s Area Fire becomes filled with flak for 1 round. The flak deals 5d4 piercing damage to Medium or smaller starships that move through that zone (DC 29 basic Reflex save). A starship that ends its movement in the zone or starts its movement in the zone is unaffected. System Shock A starship that takes damage from the Opulus Drift Cruiser’s EMP cannon must succeed at a DC 29 Fortitude save or its generator battle station becomes malfunctioning (DC 29 to Repair Station). On a critical hit, Repairing the Station requires a DC 31 Computers or Crafting check.

actions.name: Charity Lance
actions.text: The central spire of the Gold Bazaar fires a shimmering beam in a 6-zone line. Enemies in the area take 8d8 fire damage (DC 34 basic Will save). A starship that fails this save takes a –1-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round as spectral molten gold clings to its hull. Profligate Prophecy is immediately recharged.

actions.name: Contractual Obligations
actions.text: The Gold Bazaar opens a one-way line of communication between one of its negotiators and a starship within sensor range. The Gold Bazaar attempts to Demoralize a creature helming a battle station on the target starship. On a success or critical success, the target must also choose one of the following. Non-Compete The Gold Bazaar gains resistance 10 to damage from the target starship as long as the target is frightened. Non-Disclosure The target’s frightened value doesn’t decrease at the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Money is Time
actions.text: The Gold Bazaar’s executive approves overtime pay for all employees on the starship. The Gold Bazaar is quickened for 1 minute and can use the additional action only to Boost Thrusters or Change Heading.

actions.name: Profligate Prophecy
actions.text: Frequency once per day and recharges when the Gold Bazaar uses Charity Lance; Effect The Gold Bazaar’s pious residents trade a portion of the day’s profits for assistance from Abadar. The first time the Gold Bazaar succeeds at an attack roll this turn, that attack becomes a critical success.
